The Streets and Capital Improvement columns have no schedule of their own and none of their receipts are in detail (p8 all-funds budget receipt groups mix funds and were not recorded). Check: 292,985 + 105,489 + 28,417 = 426,891.

gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (printed p7): Transfers In General column 25,152 = Total 25,152 (and Transfers Out (25,152)). The General Fund combining schedule p7 (printed p21), which detail follows, prints Operating transfers in (out) General (25,152) and Park 25,125, Total '-'. The Park figure is printed 27 lower than the matching General outflow, and Park's own line (64,611) + 25,125 = (39,486) does not equal its printed (39,459) (which implies 25,152): the report itself does not add up. Detail keeps the printed 25,125; 25,152 - 25,125 = 27 = gap. No fix (printed amount kept; recorded in report_discrepancies).

Proprietary funds statement p6 (printed p9): Charges for services Water 121,140 + Sewer 177,394; Other operating receipts Sewer 95 (total operating receipts 298,629); nonoperating Utility advance deposits Water 6,202. Detail has no business-type revenue lines at all (only the p8 budget expenditure lines for Water and Sewer; the p8 receipt groups mix funds). Fix: add the 4 printed fund-column lines. Check: 0 + 121,140 + 177,394 + 95 + 6,202 = 304,831.
